name: Unrecognised
description: The capability is not in the capability model, whatever else exists.

name: Named
description: A capability document gives it an identifier, a level, a parent where its level needs one, a purpose, and the demand it answers: an outcome, or a claim recorded as an assumption.

name: Bounded
description: The ABBs it needs are named and each declares what it requires. Non-goals are written down. Every open question with more than one credible answer is a consideration, or the capability declares it has none.

name: Decided
description: Every consideration is resolved by an accepted decision record, and a pattern that realises the capability is logical: every box is an ABB.

name: Buildable
description: Every ABB is realised by an accepted SBB, the running cost is modelled, and a realising pattern is physical: every box is an SBB.

name: Proven
description: An implementation exercises the pattern end to end, and the evidence that it meets the capability's criteria is linked from the pattern. Received from implementation.

name: In service
description: It runs for real, with an owner, a runbook and a measure reported against the outcome it serves. Received from implementation.
